description: This file contains the DateParts class, which provides static methods to extract date components (day, month, year) from various date representations for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: DateParts
classes.description: Provides static methods to extract day, month, and year parts from various date formats used in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Returns the day of the month for a given date value, supporting multiple input types and array inputs.

methods.name: month
methods.description: Returns the month (1-12) for a given date value, handling different calendar systems and input types.

methods.name: year
methods.description: Returns the year (1900-9999) for a given date value, supporting array inputs and various date formats.

methods.name: weirdCondition
methods.description: Handles special cases for date values, particularly for compatibility with different Excel calendars and functions.
